result:
PR #175 is ready, green, and mergeable. Done.

**What the previous attempt left, and why:** attempt 1 ran out of turns with the work finished but **uncommitted**. The pushed head `06c8d6efa5` was an earlier state, and all three CI failures were in this lane's own selftest fragment — already repaired in the worktree, never committed. I recorded that in `NOTES.md` as asked, committed the repairs, and did not re-derive the fix.

**The three red checks, and what was actually wrong with each:**

| CI failure | cause |
|---|---|
| `b: the PR is told the session ended without a next state` | the fixture counted every `COMMENT 141`, but `cloud.sh` comments at **claim** as well as in `finish` — it counts the notice's own words now |
| `an unreadable label list is retried three times…` | the right count is **four** reads (the retry loop's three plus `label_rm`'s own); three alone is equally consistent with retrying and then giving up |
| `and finish goes on anyway…` | it asserted a `DELETE` that *cannot* happen — with the labels endpoint down, `label_rm` returns 1 without attempting it. Replaced with the tick-log line naming which path `finish` took |

**One failure was not mine.** Locally, `selftest.d/60-status.sh` (`[lane.statusfresh]`'s) went red: it wrote a hardcoded `2026-09-19T01:10Z` row into a table `status.sh` filters to the last 24h, so it flipped red on every branch at ~01:26Z. `origin/master` had already fixed it with relative stamps. Merging master cleared it; nothing in this lane to change.

**State now:**
- `818582b012` — selftest and both builds **pass**, `MERGEABLE`, draft cleared.
- Merged `origin/master` (42 commits) at `73f8d3afbb`, **clean**. Local suite: 980 passed, 0 failed. `preflight.sh --allow-tracker` passed, territory and coverage gates included.
- `Files:` in the body matches `git diff --stat origin/master...HEAD` exactly — four files. `gh-label.sh` was added to that line; it is comment-only, held by no territory row and named by no other open PR.
- Prediction: none, stated in the body — harness-only, moves no pixels.

Two things for the board rather than for me: **#171 merged at 02:37Z**, so `[lane.turncap]`'s grant on `docs/testing/jobs/cloud.sh` is now the stale row (I have not touched `territory.toml`), and the ready PR carries no pipeline label because `needs-audit-1` is the board's to apply per `ORCHESTRATION-DESIGN.md:245`. The fold-order request the body made is discharged regardless — the two `cloud.sh` hunks were genuinely disjoint and master merged without conflict.
